subject: Request: 3yr Rate Ceiling w/ Step-down Trigger & Rollback Protections — AsterHealth
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: 3yr Rate Ceiling w/ Step-down Trigger & Rollback Protections — AsterHealth

Team —

Quick summary: AsterHealth (Sam & Priya on copy) have signed up to a 3-year committed consumption plan. They are asking for a 36-month price lock (list-based ceiling) and an unusual step-down mechanism if their usage declines >25% year-over-year, plus automatic rollback protection on renewal for year 4 if market list increases more than 8%. Their procurement needs these baked into the commercial terms to proceed to legal and DocuSign.

Numbers: proposed committed spend $5.4M over 3 years; ask is 28% off list, with the following asks that deviate from standard playbook: 
- 36-month rate ceiling (no increases above agreed list-adjusted baseline)
- annual uplift cap: CPI or 3% whichever is lower (they push for 0–3%)
- step-down: if consumption drops >25% in a consecutive 12mo window, their committed unit price steps down by 8% for remaining term
- renewal rollback protection: if market list rises >8% at renewal, their renewal rate may not exceed prior-year effective rate + 3% unless usage materially increases

Why this is high-risk: multi-year price exposure + non-standard step-down and rollback language could set a precedent. Need executive run-rate approval (commercial + finance + legal) to accept non-standard caps and the step-down trigger. I propose we request a one-time exec approval limited to this deal with a clear memo and an internal guardrail: approval contingent on finance signoff of downside P&L and Legal inserting a defined re-opener for extraordinary market moves.

Attachments: SOW and my annotated redlines (attached).

Ask: Ben / Marissa — can you please route for commercial exec approval? Laura — can you review and OK escalation to the AE/RevOps council? If we get a conditional green by EOD Monday we can hit their deadline.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redlines_AsterHealth.docx (commercial redlines)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-04-02T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3yr Rate Ceiling w/ Step-down Trigger & Rollback Protections — AsterHealth

Adding some framing and suggested alternative language — copying in the commercial playbook.

Quick notes: 
- We should offer a capped step-down (max 8% as Sean suggested) but limit triggers to absolute $ variance (e.g., 25% of committed ARR) AND require a remediation period (90 days) before automatic step-down kicks in. That protects us against short-term volume fluctuation.
- For renewal rollback protection, propose a grandfather clause that only applies if AsterHealth maintains >=85% of committed usage during the prior 12 months. If they fall below that, standard renewal terms apply.
- Recommend Finance run a 3-year downside stress (best/likely/worst) and we put a 12-month clawback if usage recovers.

I've attached a redlined terms doc with the proposed language. If we agree, Ben — can you prepare the approval memo for exec signature with an ask: one-time deviation approval for up to 30% discount and the step-down/rollback carve-outs?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redlines_AsterHealth.docx (proposed commercial redlines)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3yr Rate Ceiling w/ Step-down Trigger & Rollback Protections — AsterHealth

Thanks for the context. A few clarifying Qs before I take to the Exec Commercial Committee: 
1) What is the projected 36-month blended margin at the proposed discount and potential step-down scenario (finance stress test)?
2) Is procurement insisting the rollback protection be unconditional or will they accept a usage threshold?
3) Any regulatory/data residency constraints that would materially increase cost?

I agree with Marissa that a remediation window and a clawback on recovery are reasonable constraints. If Finance signs off on the downside and Legal confirms the clean re-opener language, I'm willing to sign a conditional exception limited to this account with the following guardrails: (a) approval expires if not closed within 60 days, (b) we add explicit audit rights for usage verification, (c) a minimum commitment floor of $1.5M/year for the first two years.

Please provide answers inline and Ben, please prepare the memo for my review.

Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3yr Rate Ceiling w/ Step-down Trigger & Rollback Protections — AsterHealth

Laura / team —

I ran a quick finance pass (attached memo). High level: under the proposed commercial structure, blended margin holds at ~41% in the base case, down to ~29% in the worst-case scenario (sustained step-down + low adoption). That's outside of ideal but acceptable with the following exec conditions: 
- Approval limited to this named account and this single agreement (no precedent language in templates)
- 12-month clawback on net present value if usage rebounds >30% within a single 12mo window
- Audit & telemetry rights explicitly added to contract (revops to own ingestion verification)
- Approval memo signed by VP Commercial and CFO delegate (I have ben.carter@redwood.com sign-off pending CFO confirmation)

I'm attaching the approval memo for Laura's signature. If Laura signs, I'll route to Legal to finalize and then to Sean to close with Aster.

Ben

- One-time executive exception for a 3-year rate ceiling with the step-down capped at 8% and a 90-day remediation period before it applies.
- Renewal rollback protection honored only if AsterHealth maintains >=85% committed usage in the prior 12 months; otherwise renewals revert to standard terms.
- 12-month clawback if usage rebounds >30% in a single 12mo window.
- Audit & telemetry verification will be implemented to validate consumption.

Next steps: Legal will send the redline and DocuSign envelope by end of week. Please review the SOW and the contract redlines when you receive them.
